keep_features.feature_value: slur/insult-like informal phrasing and confrontational tone
keep_features.rationale: Uses direct, informal adversarial phrasing rather than neutral discussion.

keep_features.feature_value: emphatic exclamatory/intensity style with multiple clause punch
keep_features.evidence_span: "EU, just tax back big time and Trump will fold like the little bitch he is"
keep_features.rationale: Single sentence with strong imperative plus insult for emphasis.

keep_features.feature_value: political figure + act reference + party constituency language
keep_features.evidence_span: "Senate Majority Leader, John Thune" ... "SAVE AMERICA ACT"
keep_features.rationale: Contains multiple named entities and a specific legislative act.

keep_features.feature_value: tax share argument with cause/effect about jobs/donations
keep_features.evidence_span: "pay ~40% of taxes" ... "provide jobs" ... "donate to civil projects"
keep_features.rationale: Claims different groups’ economic contributions and redirects blame to alleged problem actors.

keep_features.feature_value: accuses "fraudsters stealing" tax dollars as underlying cause
keep_features.rationale: Uses accusation of deception/fraud to explain political disagreement.

keep_features.feature_value: states gun policy position tied to background checks as unconstitutional
keep_features.evidence_span: "background checks on private sales are an unconstitutional infringement"
keep_features.rationale: Explicitly asserts a normative/prescriptive constitutional claim about gun policy.
Direct command to behave in a particular way.

keep_features.feature_value: conditional proposal/justification leading to conclusion (if/only way language)
keep_features.evidence_span: "It's the only way things ever get better."
keep_features.rationale: Justifies a proposed political action using a restrictive conclusion pattern.

remove_features.evidence_span: "I don't want that shit in my country"
"ICE stop acting like a Nazi gestapo"
remove_features.rationale: Uses persecution/historical atrocity analogy to delegitimize a group.

remove_features.feature_value: lists many disinformation/conspiracy claims as coordinated threats
remove_features.evidence_span: "disinformation and conspiracies like Flat Earth, QAnan/Pizza-gate"
remove_features.rationale: Accumulates conspiracy-theory references as an explanatory backdrop.

remove_features.feature_value: ALL CAPS + long emphatic statement style
remove_features.rationale: Uppercase emphasis and exclamation-heavy moral-mission phrasing.

remove_features.feature_value: cheering destruction language to harm target
remove_features.rationale: Expresses hostile intent toward a named political figure.

remove_features.feature_value: uses censored profanity and aggressive dismissal
remove_features.rationale: Contains direct profanity aimed at an outgroup.

remove_features.feature_value: insult list targeting personal traits and criminal claims
remove_features.rationale: Uses harsh personal/sexual-crime accusations and demeaning physical descriptors.
Directly references gun-free society and repeal of Second Amendment.
